name: Chemistry Atlas
desc: A detailed, interactive course through university chemistry: from atoms and bonding to thermodynamics, kinetics, quantum chemistry, organic and inorganic chemistry, spectroscopy, biochemistry and materials.
desc_zh: 深入、可交互的大学化学课程：从原子与化学键，到热力学、动力学、量子化学、有机与无机化学、波谱、生物化学与材料。
lede: A detailed, interactive course through university chemistry — from atoms and bonding to thermodynamics, kinetics, quantum chemistry, organic, inorganic and analytical chemistry, biochemistry and materials. This is a skeleton: the courses and chapters are mapped out, and the lessons are still to be written.
lede_zh: 深入、可交互的大学化学课程——从原子与化学键，到热力学、动力学、量子化学、有机化学、无机化学、分析化学、生物化学与材料。目前这是一个框架：课程与章节已经规划好，课文尚待编写。
foot: a free, detailed and interactive tour of the undergraduate chemistry curriculum, written to be read alongside lectures and textbooks.
foot_zh: 一套免费、详尽、可交互的大学本科化学课程导览，可配合课堂和教材阅读。
about_lede: Chemistry Atlas is a free, detailed tour of the chemistry taught in a university degree — written to be read alongside lectures and textbooks, or on its own.
about_lede_zh: 化学图谱是一套免费、详尽的大学化学导览——可以配合课堂和教材阅读，也可以单独自学。
timeline_desc: From the chemical revolution to the periodic table and quantum chemistry: the discoveries behind every course in the atlas.
timeline_desc_zh: 从化学革命到元素周期表和量子化学：图谱中每门课程背后的发现。
timeline_lede: The discoveries behind the courses, from Lavoisier’s conservation of mass and Mendeleev’s periodic table to quantum chemistry, modern synthesis and computation. Coloured dots show the area of chemistry; links lead to the course where the idea is taught.
timeline_lede_zh: 各门课程背后的发现：从拉瓦锡的质量守恒和门捷列夫的元素周期表，到量子化学、现代合成与计算化学。彩色圆点表示所属化学领域；链接指向讲授该内容的课程。
card_desc: University chemistry: general and physical chemistry, inorganic and organic chemistry, analytical chemistry and spectroscopy, biochemistry and medicinal chemistry, materials, polymers and the environment. The curriculum is mapped out; the lessons are still to be written.
card_desc_zh: 大学化学：普通化学与物理化学、无机化学与有机化学、分析化学与波谱、生物化学与药物化学、材料、高分子与环境。课程体系已经规划好，课文尚待编写。

areas.label: General chemistry
areas.blurb: Atoms, molecules, reactions and the quantitative language of chemistry.
areas.blurb_zh: 原子、分子、化学反应以及化学的定量语言。

areas.label: Physical chemistry
areas.blurb: Energy, equilibrium, rates, electrochemistry and the quantum theory of molecules.
areas.blurb_zh: 能量、平衡、速率、电化学以及分子的量子理论。

areas.label: Inorganic chemistry
areas.blurb: The elements and their compounds: main-group, transition-metal and organometallic chemistry.
areas.blurb_zh: 元素及其化合物：主族、过渡金属与金属有机化学。

areas.label: Organic chemistry
areas.blurb: Carbon compounds: structure, reactivity, mechanism and synthesis.
areas.blurb_zh: 碳化合物：结构、反应性、反应机理与合成。

areas.label: Analytical chemistry & spectroscopy
areas.blurb: Measuring what is there and how much: laboratory practice, separations, instruments and structure determination.
areas.blurb_zh: 测定物质的组成与含量：实验室操作、分离、仪器分析与结构鉴定。

areas.label: Chemistry of life
areas.blurb: Biomolecules, enzymes, metabolism and the design of medicines.
areas.blurb_zh: 生物分子、酶、代谢与药物设计。

areas.label: Materials, environment & industry
areas.blurb: Solids, polymers, the environment and chemistry at industrial scale.
areas.blurb_zh: 固体、高分子、环境以及工业规模的化学。
